mapper.insert: insert into users (login_id, password, name, birth_date, gender, email) values (#{loginId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{birthDate}, #{gender}, #{email})
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, login_id, password, name, birth_date, gender, email, del_yn FROM users WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND del_yn = 'N'
select count(*) from users where login_id = #{loginId} and del_yn='N'
select count(*) from users where email = #{email} and del_yn = 'N'
